notes: The Go registry preserves C's POS_STANDING/level-0 entry gate (R2/R5e).
An outdoor actor receives C's exact outside refusal before any exit scan (R1/R5e).
C do_leave does not parse its argument; the Go no-argument wrapper likewise ignores trailing text (R1/R2/R5e).
An indoor room without an open exit to an outdoor destination receives C's exact terminal refusal (R1/R5e).
The first qualifying indoor-to-outdoor exit invokes canonical perform_move and gives the actor the destination observation; shared movement branches remain owned by movement.tsv (R1/R2/R5e).
The origin peer receives the direction-specific C leave act from the selected south exit (R1/R4/R5e).
The destination peer receives canonical arrival bytes; full perform_move audience topology is delegated to movement.tsv (R1/R4/R5e).
Sleeping input is rejected at the registered POS_STANDING gate before do_leave's indoor/outdoor logic (R1/R2/R5e).
